title: Payments
summary: Create and revise editable local invoice drafts from to-dos or manual lines, attach one receipt file to each line with receipt reuse across lines, track payment status, and optionally complete, preview, confirm, send, and track Stripe-hosted invoices.

batch.reason: One draft owns one payer, currency, line snapshot set, preview digest, and later confirmation boundary.
An invoice revision is guarded by one exact preview digest.

delete.reason: Invoices are retained as financial history; no destructive invoice deletion operation is exposed.

resources.title: Invoice line receipt
resources.summary: A snapshot-qualified receipt file attached to one invoice line.

batch.reason: Receipt changes are one part of an exact digest-guarded invoice revision.
Receipt snapshot changes are one part of an exact digest-guarded invoice revision.
Receipt removal is one part of an exact digest-guarded invoice revision.
